tools.name: search

tools.name: latest_papers
tools.description: New AI papers from arXiv, newest first or by ByteTrail's relevance score, with excerpt, authors and links.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description: One paper: full abstract, authors, fields, whether it has code or a model, and its links.

tools.name: latest_news
tools.description:
The newest posts from AI labs, universities, news sites, engineering blogs and newsletters: headline, short
excerpt and link (never the full article).

tools.name: trending
tools.description: What's rising in AI right now, by kind.

tools.name: funding_rounds
tools.description:
Recent funding rounds of AI and developer-tool startups: company, amount, stage, investors, source and,
when one exists, the SEC Form D filing. `flags` say what to check before trusting a round.

tools.name: company
tools.description:
One startup on ByteTrail Market: what it does, website, location, founders, every funding round, and its
GitHub and Hugging Face presence.

tools.name: dev_tools
tools.description: AI developer tools (frameworks, libraries, databases) with weekly downloads, stars and growth.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: One developer tool: description, GitHub repo, packages, stars, downloads, releases and its rank in Rising.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
